name: Beguile
body:
School enchantment (charm) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 move action
Components V

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one humanoid creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cloud the mind of the target creature, making him more susceptible to charms and illusions. The subject is dazzled and takes a -4 circumstance penalty on all saving throws against enchantment and illusion spells and effects. A successful Will save negates the dazzled condition and the target suffers only a -2 circumstance penalty on all saving throws against enchantment and illusion spells and effects.
